draft.title: The internal environment
card: The internal environment is everything inside a business that its owners and managers can control and change. It is the opposite of the external environment, which a business cannot control.
Its parts include the products it sells, its location, and its resources: people, money and equipment.
It also includes management, which is how decisions are made and who makes them, and culture, which is the shared values and habits of the people at work.
Because the business controls these things, it can change them to respond to outside pressures. For example, a business can train staff or change its prices, but it cannot change interest rates.
draft.remember: Internal means inside the business and under its control.

a.q: Which of these is part of a business's internal environment?
opts: The training it gives its staff
The interest rate set by the Reserve Bank
A rival opening a shop next door
A new law on workplace safety
a.why: Staff training is a decision made inside the business, so the business controls it. The other three come from outside and the business cannot control them, even though a rival's shop feels close to home.
a.clue: Which one can the business decide for itself?

b.q: Priya owns a bakery in Ballarat. Sales fall because a new supermarket opens nearby. She decides to bring in a new range of sourdough loaves. What is the new range an example of?
opts: An internal change, made in response to an outside force
An external change, made in response to an inside force
An outside force that she cannot control
An internal change with no link to the supermarket
b.why: Choosing which products to sell is a decision inside the business, so it is part of the internal environment. The supermarket is the external force that prompted it. The reason for a change does not make the change itself external.
b.clue: Who decides what the bakery sells, and what caused the decision?

a.best: The training it gives its staff

b.best: An internal change, made in response to an outside force
